localQwen.promptMode.description: System prompt style injected into model requests. guided=workflow guidance, minimal=very short environment hint, none=no additional system prompt (tools + workspace snapshot only).

localQwen.toolsPolicy.description: Controls whether tools are passed to the model. disabled=advice-only (no tool calls), which closely matches running ollama directly without Copilot tooling.

localQwen.enableWorkspaceSnapshot.description: When disabled, skips injecting the large workspace snapshot (file tree + open files) into model prompts. Tools still work; the model must use read_file and other tools to inspect files explicitly.

localQwen.sanitizeCopilotPreamble.description: When enabled, sanitizes the large host/Copilot preamble in outbound messages while preserving tool-usage semantics. This reduces prompt bloat and repetitive instruction noise.

localQwen.compactCopilotPreamble.description: When sanitizeCopilotPreamble is enabled, applies stronger preamble compaction to keep only high-signal guidance and drop verbose boilerplate.

localQwen.outboundLogEnabled.description: When enabled, appends the exact outbound messages/tools payload sent to Ollama into a workspace-local JSONL log file. WARNING: may include file contents and other sensitive context from the workspace snapshot.

localQwen.outboundLogFile.description: Log filename (relative to workspace root) or absolute path used when outboundLogEnabled=true.

localQwen.latestDebugSnapshotEnabled.description: When enabled, writes a single workspace-local JSON snapshot that is overwritten each request (prevents stale debug accumulation). The snapshot excludes full file contents by default.

localQwen.latestDebugSnapshotFile.description: Path (relative to workspace root) where the latest debug snapshot is written when latestDebugSnapshotEnabled=true. This file is overwritten each request.

localQwen.endpoint.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.

localQwen.model.description: Default Ollama model name used by the chat participant agent.

localQwen.visionModel.description: Optional Ollama vision model name used to extract screenshot state for non-vision chat models (for example: llava:13b).

localQwen.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for Ollama requests. Lower values produce more deterministic output.

localQwen.maxAgentSteps.description: Maximum number of internal tool-call steps per chat participant agent turn.

localQwen.requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP request timeout (ms) for Ollama chat/generate calls. Set to 0 for no timeout.

localQwen.modelListTimeoutMs.description: HTTP request timeout (ms) for Ollama model list requests.

localQwen.allowOutsideWorkspaceFileOps.description: Allow the agent's file tools (read_file, write_file, edit_file, etc.) to operate outside the current workspace root. Disabled by default for safety.

localQwen.enableMachineInteractionTools.description: Opt-in: enable screenshot/OCR/window/GUI input tools (take_screenshot, ocr_find_text, gui_*, list_windows, focus_window, launch_app, wait_for_condition). Disabled by default for safety.

localQwen.toolDiscoveryRoots.description: Additional absolute paths to scan for tool_* handler exports at extension activation. Empty array means only the built-in handlers are used.

localQwen.maxToolSourceFiles.description: Maximum number of source files scanned per tool discovery root.

localQwen.maxToolSourceBytes.description: Maximum total bytes read across all tool source files during discovery.

localQwen.performanceProfile.description: Latency/quality tradeoff for local Ollama requests. quality keeps more context/tool detail, fast prioritizes first-token speed, balanced is an in-between default.

localQwen.enablePlanningAndChecklists.description: When enabled, the local model defaults to a plan + internal checklist + iterative loop workflow for complex tasks, anchored to .github/completion-checklist.md when present. Disable to fall back to a simpler, less-structured workflow.

localQwen.pinCopilotSubagentModels.description: When enabled, auto-pins Copilot plan/implement/search subagent model settings to the first discovered local-ollama model. Disabled by default to preserve existing Copilot quality settings.

localQwen.maxAutonomousTurns.description: Maximum number of agent turns in /autonomous mode before forced stop.

localQwen.maxIdleTurns.description: Maximum consecutive turns with no file mutations before the agent receives an escalation prompt.

scripts.test:e2e:quality:strict: LOCAL_QWEN_E2E=1 LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_MIN_OVERALL=8 LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_MAX_FIRST_TOKEN_MS=20000 LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_MAX_TOTAL_MS=120000 npm run test:extension
scripts.test:e2e:deep-correctness:strict: LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_DEEP=1 LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_DEEP_MIN_FORMAT=0.9 LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_DEEP_MIN_USEFUL=0.9 LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_DEEP_MIN_CASE_USEFUL=0.75 LOCAL_QWEN_E2E_DEEP_MIN_OVERALL=0.9 npm run test:extension
scripts.test:e2e:copilot-compat:goal: LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT=1 LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT_MAX_CASES=200 LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT_MIN_PASS_RATE=1 LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT_TIMEOUT_MS=1800000 npm run test:extension
scripts.test:e2e:copilot-compat:full: LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT=1 LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT_MAX_CASES=0 LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT_MIN_PASS_RATE=1 LOCAL_QWEN_COPILOT_COMPAT_DISABLE_TIMEOUT=1 npm run test:extension
scripts.test:e2e:intent-probe:strict: LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_ROUNDS=3 LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_MIN_INTENT_SIGNAL_RATE=1 LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_MIN_GOOD_VERDICT_RATE=1 LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_MIN_REQUEST_ALIGNMENT=8 LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_MIN_REQUEST_ALIGNMENT_RATE=1 LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_MIN_STEP_EFFICIENCY=9 LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_MAX_REPETITION_EVENTS=2 LOCAL_QWEN_PROBE_MAX_CONTEXT_DRIFT_RATE=0 node ./scripts/e2e-intent-probe.cjs
scripts.test:quality:strict: npm run test:e2e:quality:strict && npm run test:e2e:deep-correctness:strict && npm run test:e2e:intent-probe:strict && npm run test:e2e:stability:strict
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:extension && npm run test:e2e:stability:strict && npm run test:e2e:intent-probe:strict
scripts.coverage: rm -rf .coverage && mkdir -p .coverage/tmp && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=.coverage/tmp npm run test:all && c8 report --temp-directory .coverage/tmp --report-dir .coverage --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --include='dist-test/src/tools/**' --exclude='**/handlers.js' && c8 check-coverage --temp-directory .coverage/tmp --include='dist-test/src/tools/**' --exclude='**/handlers.js' --lines 100 --functions 100 --branches 100 --statements 100
